title: Trace existence and central averaging
scope: Finite center-valued traces, normal corner-trace extension, semifinite scalar traces and simultaneous norm averaging, with arbitrary centers, Hilbert dimensions and increasing nets. The accompanying bounded-topology and tracial-normality proofs supply the stated analytic foundations.
